# src/Connector.Core/DynamicExport

Layer **domain** · project `Connector.Core`

Project navigation: [Connector.Core](../projects/Connector-Core-67ea6c7c243a.md)

## Overview 🤖

Contains records and classes for configuring and normalizing export mappings for data connectors.

**Responsibilities.** Defines the structure and normalization logic for export mappings, including fields, relations, and nested groups.

**Usage.** Used by various parts of the Connector application to configure and process data exports.

_AI draft from the facts on this page; review it, then write the module's documentation yourself._

## Key components

|---|---|---|---|
| [ExportMappingJson](#exportmappingjson) | class | 9 | Deserializes `ExportMappingConfig` stored as AppSetting JSON, repairing configs saved before relations gained a Fields list, Delimiter, and relation-level FlattenStrategy: System.Text.Json leaves a missing property at its type default — `null` for the string and array properties here — rather than the value the old shape implied, which crashes every consumer that dereferences it. Every read of the export_mapping/export_presets AppSetting values must go through this instead of a raw `Deserialize`\<T>` call. |
| [ExportNodeJson](#exportnodejson) | class | 9 | Deserializes an `ExportNode` tree stored as JSON (on ExportDefinitionEntity.RootNode), backfilling missing properties the same way `ExportMappingJson` does for the legacy mapping shape: System.Text.Json leaves a missing property at its type default rather than the value an older saved tree implied, which would otherwise crash every consumer that dereferences it. Every read of a persisted `ExportNode` tree must go through this instead of a raw `Deserialize`\<T>` call. |
| [ExportNode](#exportnode) | record | 4 | One node in a recursive export tree. Generalizes `ExportMappingNestedGroup` (which only covers "object"/"array" nesting for JSON output) to also represent the root and plain scalar columns, so a single tree — walked by one query builder and honored by every format writer (CSV/Excel/JSON) — replaces the old parallel Fields/Relations/NestedGroups shapes. `Children` lets root/object/array nodes nest arbitrarily deep; a scalar-field node has no children. |
| [ExportRecordSelection](#exportrecordselection) | record | 1 | Optional, server-derived root selection: the configured correlation column and caller-supplied values. The SQL compiler binds the values as parameters and intersects them with the saved root filter. |
| [ExportJsonMetadataField](#exportjsonmetadatafield) | record | 0 | One key/value pair in the JSON export's metadata block. When `IsDynamicTimestamp` is true, `Value` is ignored and the actual export timestamp is substituted at build time. |
| [ExportJsonWrapperConfig](#exportjsonwrapperconfig) | record | 0 | Configures the JSON export envelope: an optional root key, the items array key, and metadata field naming. Null on `JsonWrapper` preserves the legacy flat envelope. |
| [ExportMappingConfig](#exportmappingconfig) | record | 0 | The complete mapping config for one source table, including field remaps and relation flattening. `NestedGroups` and `JsonWrapper` are JSON-export-only and additive: CSV/Excel export and every pre-existing saved mapping ignore them entirely. |
| [ExportMappingField](#exportmappingfield) | record | 0 | A single column mapping with source name, target export name, and enabled flag. |

### ExportMappingNestedGroup

_record_ · [ExportMappingTypes.cs](../../src/Connector.Core/DynamicExport/ExportMappingTypes.cs#L30)

A JSON-only nested structure: either a single embedded object (Kind="object", an N:1 lookup join) or an array of embedded objects (Kind="array", a 1:N join). `Children` lets groups nest arbitrarily deep (e.g. item → manufacturer → addresses), each recursing within its parent's JSON expression.

_Linked tests:_ `DynamicExportServiceNestedJsonPostgresTests.ExecuteNestedJsonQueryAsync_ArrayKindGroup_EmbedsArrayOfObjects`, `DynamicExportServiceNestedJsonPostgresTests.ExecuteNestedJsonQueryAsync_DisabledGroupAndDisabledField_AreExcluded`, `DynamicExportServiceNestedJsonPostgresTests.ExecuteNestedJsonQueryAsync_GdprDeniedField_ExcludedEvenWhenRenamed`, `DynamicExportServiceNestedJsonPostgresTests.ExecuteNestedJsonQueryAsync_GdprDeniedField_StrippedFromNestedObject`, `DynamicExportServiceNestedJsonPostgresTests.ExecuteNestedJsonQueryAsync_ObjectKindGroupWithMultipleMatches_ThrowsActionableError`, `DynamicExportServiceNestedJsonPostgresTests.ExecuteNestedJsonQueryAsync_ObjectKindGroup_EmbedsSingleNestedObject`, `DynamicExportServiceNestedJsonPostgresTests.ExecuteNestedJsonQueryAsync_TwoHopNesting_ChildGroupNestsUnderParentKey`, `DynamicExportServiceNestedJsonPostgresTests.ExecuteNestedJsonQueryAsync_ZeroMatchingRelatedRows_YieldsEmptyArrayNotNull`, +6 more — test code that uses it, not coverage
